37:2.text: who drive the clouds in a good way.

37:3.text: who bring the Book and the Qur’ân from Allâh to mankind

37:5.text: Lord of the heavens and of the earth, and all that is between them, and Lord of every point of the sun’s risings.

37:6.text: Verily We have adorned the near heaven with the stars

37:7.text: And to guard against every rebellious devil.

37:8.text: They cannot listen to the higher group
for they are pelted from every side.

37:9.text: Outcast, and theirs is a constant

37:10.text: Except such as snatch away something by stealing, and they are pursued by a flaming fire of piercing brightness.

37:11.text: (i.e. these polytheists, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)
: "Are they stronger as creation, or those
(others like the heavens and the earth and the mountains)
whom We have created?" Verily, We created them of a sticky clay.

37:13.text: And when they are reminded, they pay no attention.

37:14.text: And when they see an Ayâh
from Allâh, they mock at it.

37:15.text: And they say: "This is nothing but evident magic!

37:16.text: "When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we

37:18.text: : "Yes, and you shall then be humiliated."

37:19.text: It will be a single Zajrah
[shout (i.e. the second blowing of the Trumpet)]
, and behold, they will be staring!

37:20.text: They will say: "Woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense!"

37:21.text: : "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."

37:22.text: (It will be said to the angels)
: "Assemble those who did wrong, together with their companions
and what they used to worship,

37:23.text: "Instead of Allâh, and lead them on to the way of flaming Fire

37:24.text: "But stop them, verily they are to be questioned.
